disposition: Cleared for the bounded default Button label fitting correction, with the audit typo fixed in afd1caca3471cfa361f4e29cf0a9d3fae7f075bc. No product source finding remains in this increment.

source_evidence.decision: The default LABEL renderer uses the existing shared grapheme-aware cell-width truncate operation and fills the same resolved label rectangle before painting. Registration, state derivation, bindings, marker/icon slots, geometry, cursor behavior, and measurement are unchanged. Explicit LABEL callbacks remain outside the default truncation and padding branch.
The frozen Button calls ui::text::fit with the label cell width. The fixed design revision contains the identical call.

Frozen truncate iterates graphemes, reserves one cell for ellipsis, and does not split wide graphemes. fit pads the resulting content to the allocated width. Shared candidate truncate plus resolved label fill follows that contract.

Four unchanged external public consumer tests pass. Covers 世界 at width 5, combining graphemes, emoji, checked markers, empty and zero-to-three-cell extents, custom LABEL slot ownership, and all four color profiles. Seven other tests filtered.
